metric_note: success_at_1 and success_at_5 count questions whose gold value string appears in the top 1 or top 5 hit texts. One gold value per question, so this is success@k, not set-recall. ndcg_at_10 is binary nDCG with one relevant hit (see ndcg_at_10 in this harness and rag/metrics.py). It is not success@k.
honesty: Retrieval only, hash embedder, committed documents under tests/RAG/real_docs, no model call. Gold is a value (a code), not merely that some passage was returned. cross_file asks for a code that is not in the memo the city appears in. Measures; rag/ was not tuned to this pack. A saturated success@5 would mean the pack is not harder than the paraphrase board.
provenance_note: commit_sha is the git HEAD the harness process ran against. generated_at is the wall clock of that process. A drift check ignores both, plus timings, space ids and absolute paths.
